data_plan: 15-minute bars, crypto30 panel, Binance Vision monthly klines via the programme's verified loader (Stratex/rigorous_backtest/data_feed.py load_dataset), months 2023-10..2026-10, 108,192 bars per symbol, zero missing bars — the identical panel and loader the Box Theory and S-RD1 declared runs use. Provenance: ~/workspace/srd1-runprep/panel_provenance.json (SHA-256 1eeea5cdad831cc0338c41f4cb7aaf684cf9d80fecbd6fa19f645652bb464517), cross-verified at declaration time against Stratex/rigorous_backtest/ig/box_theory_provenance.json on origin/main (30/30 csv_sha256 match) plus an in-memory loader spot-verification of sample symbols. Daily bars are derived by the declared aggregation only; no new data source is introduced. Free and keyless. The run is a separate, later step and is NOT part of the declaring step.

declared_conventions.aggregation: Daily bars are aggregated from the declared 15m panel by UTC calendar day: open = first 15m open, high = max, low = min, close = last 15m close, volume = sum of 15m volumes. Only complete days (exactly 96 15m bars) are used. The declared panel is complete (zero missing bars), so it yields exactly 1,127 daily bars per symbol, 2023-10-01..2026-10-31, on an identical date index for all 30 symbols; the harness asserts the identical index and aborts on any deviation.
declared_conventions.bracket_anchoring: RD-002's declaration states ATR(14) brackets without pinning the anchor arithmetic in text. Convention frozen here: ATR is evaluated at the signal bar j (causal), and the stop/target levels are anchored to the actual entry fill (the open of bar j+1): stop = entry -/+ 2.0 * ATR_j, target = entry +/- 4.0 * ATR_j.
declared_conventions.median: The baseline median of 12 values is statistics.median (mean of the 6th and 7th order statistics).
declared_conventions.position_sizing: The bar judges per-trade expectancy / profit factor, which are sizing-invariant; no sizing rule is part of this family's backtest identity. If the candidate ever reaches forward testing it inherits the fleet-standard decided risk package (FWD-006) unchanged, as with SRS and S-RD1.
declared_conventions.tie_break: Ranking ties are broken by symbol name ascending — the (score, symbol) tuple sort RD-002's xs_custom_entries performs.
declared_conventions.time_exit_bar_count: MAX_BARS = 5 counts the entry bar as bar 1: the managed bars are j+1, j+2, j+3, j+4, j+5; the TIME exit fills at the close of j+5 if no barrier was touched in any of them (barriers are still checked on j+5 before the TIME exit).

differentiation: RD-002 judged the unconditional version of this construction and this declaration does not re-run it. In RD-002 batch-3 (family xs_reversal; code Stratex/rigorous_backtest/rd2/families3.py xs_reversal_fn; declared in results_rd2/batch3_declaration.json; results in results_rd2/synthesis.json), the panel was ranked by trailing L-bar return (L = 5 and L = 10), the k = 3 lowest scores were bought and the k = 3 highest sold at every 5-bar rebalance, unconditionally, with bracket_time exits (SL 2.0 x ATR(14), TP 4.0 x ATR(14), max_bars 5) and next-bar-open entries. On crypto30 — this declaration's panel — that construction lost money net of programme costs in every cell: at 1d, rev5_r5 expectancy -0.169%/trade, PF 0.957, 1,020 OOS trades, 2/5 folds positive; rev10_r5 -0.212%, PF 0.945; at 4h, PF 0.930 and 0.916. Ranking horizon class, ranking rule, rebalance cadence, tail counts and exit family of the plain construction are therefore already judged on this exact panel. What is mechanically different here is the entry event. A ranked pick is entered ONLY IF the pick's own ranking-window volume is a climax against its own trailing baseline: the sum of the symbol's daily volume over the 5-bar ranking window must be at least 1.5x the median of the 12 preceding non-overlapping 5-bar window volume sums. The conditioning variable — the moved name's own volume state — appears nowhere in the RD-002 family; it is not a point on the judged grid (whose axes were lookback, rebalance, k and the bracket). Every other element is kept identical to RD-002's rev5_r5 (lookback 5, rebalance 5, k = 3 per side, (score, symbol) tie-break, ATR(14) bracket 2.0/4.0 with max_bars 5, next-bar-open entry, programme costs), so the volume-climax gate is the single controlled difference. The claim tested is different from RD-002's: not 'extreme 5-bar cross-sectional moves revert' (judged on crypto30: on average they do not) but 'extreme 5-bar moves revert only when they are liquidity-demand moves, printed on climactic volume in the moved name; extreme moves on ordinary volume are information-driven and are excluded by construction'. Adverse prior, stated plainly: the unconditional crypto30 expectancy was negative, so this claim requires that negative expectancy to be concentrated in the non-climax subset; if it is not, this cell fails too and the family closes. Exactly one cell is declared — no grid over the climax multiple, the baseline window, the lookback, the rebalance or k exists under this declaration.

evaluation_bar.costs: programme cost model (simulator.Costs: 5 bps fee + 3 bps slippage per side, 16 bps round trip) AND a 2x-cost shadow (Costs(10, 6), 32 bps round trip); both must pass
evaluation_bar.holdout: rd.common.holdout_check must pass, applied per-symbol over all 30 panel symbols (the S-RD1 adaptation)
evaluation_bar.judgement: OOS only; parameters are frozen by this declaration — nothing is selected in-sample. Verdict rules: pooled OOS trades at programme costs < 200 -> the verdict is exactly 'insufficient OOS trades'; every bar component at BOTH cost levels -> PASS (forward-test candidate only); anything else -> FAIL and the family closes. Under the owner's standing rule, a governed module with strict OOS PF < 1.2 would be deleted; this family has no governed module — research code only.
evaluation_bar.multiple_testing: Bonferroni one-sided t-test on pooled OOS per-trade net returns against N_global = max(programme ledger entering N at run time, 3893) + 1, so the minimum denominator is 3894 and alpha <= 0.05/3894 = 1.2840e-05. The 3893 floor charges this family for the two declared cells ahead of it in the queue (SRS, one trial; S-RD1, one trial) whether or not they run first — the discovery-wave convention set by TASK-STR-RD-018. Programme counter (declared) = 3,891 at freeze time (2026-11-17, coordinator reconciliation); this declaration adds exactly ONE trial — a single frozen cell — taking the declared counter to 3,892. The run must state the N_global it used.
evaluation_bar.positive_folds: >= 4 of 5 (walk-forward folds W1..W5 of Stratex/rigorous_backtest/walkforward.py, entry-time attribution)
evaluation_bar.source: Stratex/rigorous_backtest/rd/common.py PROMOTION_BAR + programme practice (identical to the SRS and S-RD1 declarations)

temporal_holdout_v1.sets: H = trades entered in W5 (2026-07-01..2026-11-01); D = trades entered in W1..W4 (2024-07-01..2026-07-01); entry-time attribution under walkforward.FOLDS, the same sets the pooled OOS judgement uses.
temporal_holdout_v1.H5_burn_clause: Holdout judged exactly once in the single declared run. Prior computation/inspection of holdout trades or metrics, or any re-run after evaluation with changed rules/parameters/conventions/costs/panel/simulator/judging code, burns the holdout: this element FAILS permanently under this declaration.
temporal_holdout_v1.judged_at: Both cost levels (programme 16 bps AND the 2x shadow 32 bps), like every other bar component of this family; each level's H and D are computed from that level's own trade list.
temporal_holdout_v1.source: SRS TEMPORAL HOLDOUT v1 (frozen SHA-256 69d9dcefd553bb11a18cd3d2aa7ecb5d187f901ec3c3cebbe84ebc373926f7e4), in the adopted form of TASK-STR-RD-018's declaration. Added by coordinator ruling 2026-11-17 (PR #897 supervisor review, item F2) BEFORE any run of this family — the family has never run and the holdout has never been computed or inspected. On any disagreement with TEMPORAL HOLDOUT v1, the stricter reading governs.

hypothesis: On crypto30 daily bars, the cross-sectional short-term reversal that RD-002 measured as negative on average is state-dependent: the subset of extreme 5-bar moves that print on climactic volume in the moved name (a liquidity-demand / capitulation signature) reverts strongly enough over the following 5 bars to clear the programme bar net of costs under the family's judged bracket exits, while the complementary quiet-move subset — excluded here by construction — carries the negative expectancy RD-002 pooled.
known_limitations_declared_upfront: Adverse prior: the unconditional sibling cells on this panel were negative (PF 0.945-0.957 at 1d). This cell subsets a negative-expectancy stream; the bar (notably Bonferroni at N >= 3894 and the untouched holdout) is the protection against a lucky subset, and no lesser standard is claimed.

Trade-count risk is structural: the panel admits ~212 signal bars and the gate discards an unknown fraction of picks, so pooled OOS trades may land below 200, in which case the only honest verdict is 'insufficient OOS trades'. This is accepted at declaration, not discovered after the fact.

The gate uses only the moved name's own volume state. No market-wide liquidity state, no order-flow data and no funding/OI data enter this family; those are separate census slate items, not silent extensions of this one.

Daily aggregation of a 15m panel is exact for OHLCV sums but the bracket simulation is bar-level: intrabar path inside a daily bar is resolved by the programme's conservative order (stop before target), never by 15m detail. Using the 15m bars for exit resolution would be a different, undeclared instrument.

The volume baseline (median of 12 prior 5-bar windows) is a trailing statistic of the same symbol; in a strong volume trend it adapts upward, which makes the climax test stricter over time. That behaviour is intended (relative, not absolute, climax) and is frozen as declared.
promotion_path: Passing the bar makes this a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>= 100 trades AND >= 8 weeks on demo). Nothing here authorises live trading.
repo_home: Stratex/rigorous_backtest/rd19/xsrev_declaration.json + XSREV_DECLARATION.md (the run verifies the declaration hash from a fresh origin/main checkout at that path; the declaring PR is a separate step from this run-prep).

rules.eligibility: A symbol is eligible at bar j iff it has valid closes for bars j-5..j, valid volumes for bars j-64..j, and a valid ATR(14) at bar j. If fewer than 6 symbols are eligible at a signal bar, NO trades are taken at that rebalance (mirrors RD-002's len(ranked) < 2k skip).
rules.entry: At the OPEN of bar j+1 (the batch-3 / programme simulator convention: signals causal at bar close, entries execute next bar open). Entry time for fold attribution is bar j+1's timestamp.
rules.exits: Bracket, identical to RD-002 xs_reversal's spec: ATR(14) Wilder as in Stratex/rigorous_backtest/rd/common.py atr(), evaluated at the signal bar j. LONG: stop = entry_price - 2.0 * ATR_j, target = entry_price + 4.0 * ATR_j. SHORT mirrored. Exit checks run from the entry bar onward in the programme simulator's order: a bar that gaps through a level fills at the bar open; the stop is checked before the target within a bar (worst case). If neither level is touched within bars j+1..j+5, the position exits at the CLOSE of bar j+5 (exit_reason TIME). A position still open at the end of the data exits at the final close (exit_reason END_OF_DATA).
rules.frequency: One position at a time per symbol: a pick for a symbol with an open position is skipped and counted. (With rebalance 5 and max_bars 5 the prior trade has always exited by the next entry bar; the rule is declared for determinism.)
rules.gate: For each pick s at signal bar j: V_win = sum of volume_s over bars j-4..j. The baseline windows are the 12 non-overlapping 5-bar windows immediately preceding bar j-4: bars [j-64..j-60], [j-59..j-55], ..., [j-9..j-5]; V_base = median of their 12 volume sums (statistics.median: the mean of the 6th and 7th order statistics). The pick is ENTERED iff V_base > 0 AND V_win >= 1.5 * V_base. There is NO substitution: a pick that fails the gate is skipped, never replaced by the next-ranked symbol. A side may therefore enter 0, 1, 2 or 3 trades at a rebalance.
rules.no_lookahead: Ranking, gate and ATR at signal bar j use only bars <= j. The baseline windows end at bar j-5, strictly before the ranking window's first volume bar j-4. Positions are managed from bar j+1 onward.
rules.parameters_fixed: LOOKBACK = 5 bars, REBALANCE = 5 bars, K = 3 per side, CLIMAX_MULTIPLE = 1.5, BASELINE_WINDOWS = 12 windows of 5 bars, SL_ATR = 2.0, TP_ATR = 4.0, MAX_BARS = 5, ATR_PERIOD = 14 — a single frozen cell. No other variants are authorised under this declaration; trying variants means new declarations and a higher trial count.
rules.ranking: For each eligible symbol s at signal bar j: score_s = close_s[j] / close_s[j-5] - 1 (RD-002 rev5 verbatim). Rank all eligible symbols ascending by (score_s, symbol). LONG picks = the first 3 (lowest scores — the worst 5-bar performers); SHORT picks = the last 3 (highest scores — the best 5-bar performers).
rules.signal_bars: Let the common daily index have N bars (N = 1,127 on the declared panel), indexed j = 0..N-1. Signal (rebalance) bars are exactly the j with j >= 64 and (j - 64) mod 5 = 0. Signals are computed on COMPLETED daily bars only, using data up to and including bar j.
rules.timeframe: 1d (daily bars aggregated from the verified 15m panel; see data_plan and declared_conventions.aggregation)
rules.universe: crypto30 — the 30 Binance USDT-M symbols of Stratex/rigorous_backtest/rd2/panels.py CRYPTO30: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, BNBUSDT, XRPUSDT, DOGEUSDT, ADAUSDT, LTCUSDT, LINKUSDT, DOTUSDT, TRXUSDT, AVAXUSDT, NEARUSDT, ATOMUSDT, UNIUSDT, ETCUSDT, BCHUSDT, FILUSDT, APTUSDT, ARBUSDT, OPUSDT, INJUSDT, SUIUSDT, XLMUSDT, HBARUSDT, ALGOUSDT, VETUSDT, SANDUSDT, MANAUSDT, AAVEUSDT.
